items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Yes, I heard him in Sam Morgan's band as a child. He was playing with Sam Morgan at the time that I was given.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Did you hear your Fouche play?
Yes, I heard him in Sam Morgan's band as a child. He was playing with Sam Morgan at the time that I was given. He was very good.
Did he play anything like Paul? No? Was he that kind of a player or did he sound different from Paul?
